szoveg_eredeti:
Sara Fischer / Axios :

 Reddit plans to require users to log in to fully access the site in response to AI scraping and will test it in select markets outside the US this quarter   —  Reddit on Thursday said it's moving to become a primarily logged-in experience, marking one of the most significant shifts in its 21-year history.
